analysiskit

Source: CLAUDE.md

R package that runs Mixed Migration Centre 4Mi analyses locally: a dataset plus a List of Analysis (LoA) workbook in, an MMC-branded Excel results workbook out. The engine, LoA reader and exporter are the same code the Analysis Kit Shiny app uses, so keep function signatures and outputs compatible with the app. Sister package: cleaningkit (Desktopkit) produces the cleaned data this package analyses.

Environment

  • Windows. Rscript is not on PATH; call it as "/c/Program Files/R/R-4.6.1/bin/Rscript.exe" from Bash.

Dev loop

  • Full cycle: Rscript dev/setup.R (attachment updates DESCRIPTION, step 1b moves optional deps back to Suggests, then devtools::document() and devtools::check()). Always use this rather than calling attachment::att_amend_desc() alone.
  • Quick: Rscript -e "devtools::document()" and Rscript -e "devtools::test(filter = 'read_loa')" (filter = test file stem).
  • Tests: testthat 3e in tests/testthat/. helper-loa.R builds LoA fixtures; helper-snapshot.R reads saved workbooks cell by cell (value + storage type) to compare Excel output. Add or update a test with any behaviour change.

Dependencies

  • Imports stay minimal: dplyr, openxlsx, readxl, stringr, tidyr + base.
  • srvyr, survey, analysistools, cleaningtools, pak are Suggests and must stay there. They are only reached by the survey engine (an analysis row with level set) and recreate_sm_parents. Guard every use with requireNamespace(). analysistools/cleaningtools are GitHub-only.

Generated files: do not edit by hand

A PreToolUse hook blocks these; edit the source instead.

Generated Source Rebuild
man/*.Rd, NAMESPACE roxygen #' comments in R/ devtools::document()
docs/ everything (pkgdown) pkgdown::build_site(); CI also builds it

The LoA contract

inst/extdata/loa-schema.md is the specification of the LoA workbook (sheets, columns, settings). Any change to what read_loa_workbook() / build_analysis_spec() accept must update that document and inst/extdata/loa_template.xlsx in the same change.

Conventions

  • Formatting: a PostToolUse hook runs air format on each .R file Claude edits. Don’t fight it.
  • Pipes: base |> only; no magrittr.
  • Errors with stop(..., call. = FALSE), written as full sentences that say what to fix.
  • Naming: functions that execute an analysis are run_*; exported utilities are ak_*; internal helpers are ck_* and tagged @keywords internal.
  • Always call other packages with pkg::fn().

Data

Survey data is personal data about people on the move. Never commit real datasets or results workbooks; scratch outputs go in Claude outputs/ (git-ignored). inst/examples/run_analysis.R is the reference workflow.
